source_caption_text:
Future over Zaytoven keys will never get old 😮‍💨🔥

Future and Zaytoven have always been a special combination, and “Mo Reala” is a perfect example of why. Zaytoven’s piano-driven production gives Future so much room to work with, and he floats over the beat with those melodic vocals that only he can pull off.

The music video takes things in a completely different direction, with a dark, almost gothic look. From the burning roses to the strange scenes in the woods, it’s one of those visuals that sticks with you long after the song ends.

Released in 2018 as part of Zaytoven’s Trap Holizay album, “Mo Reala” is a reminder of just how good these two are together. Future over Zaytoven’s keys is an undefeated combination, and this track is proof of that.
